capabilities: Ranks notes by semantic similarity in a sidebar panel
Searches the vault by meaning from a typed query
Writes a vault insights report of suggested links, orphans and duplicates
Draws a clustered vault map of notes
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer. First run downloads model weights from Hugging Face (~110 MB CPU, ~470 MB WebGPU) and a pinned ONNX runtime; the optional reader model is 1 to 5 GB and is stored outside the vault. No telemetry; a guided offline setup exists for blocked networks.
problem: Folders and keyword search cannot show which notes are related by meaning, and cloud-based semantic tools would send note content off the machine.

relations.evidence: it works with or without the easy-links plugin

summary: Left-sidebar panel that ranks notes by semantic similarity using a local multilingual embedding model, plus link suggestions and a vault map.
